articles.title: AI 写码更多，软件产出却未增
articles.summary: Harvard 大学的研究团队利用 Jellyfish 平台数据，分析了 700 多家软件公司的开发流程。研究发现，引入 AI coding agents 后，代码行数激增 30%，但软件功能的交付速度并未提升。原因在于，AI 生成的代码质量参差不齐，导致人类审查环节成为新的瓶颈：代码审查时间平均延长 49%，修改请求翻倍。尽管 AI 能高效生成代码，但人类仍需投入大量精力进行校对和修复，最终抵消了效率红利。这项研究揭示了当前 AI 编程工具在规模化应用中的真实困境：数量不等于质量。

articles.title: ps2-web-recomp: 无需模拟器在浏览器运行PS2游戏

articles.title: 在Zig中实现类型安全的HTML模板
articles.summary: 作为一名从PHP 3.0时代就开始做Web开发的老兵，我从未想过会在Zig这种底层语言中重新探索前端。过去两年，我在构建Zio和Dusty生态系统时，发现配合arena allocators和Zig的comptime特性，甚至能打造出无需JavaScript的SPA。然而，一直缺少一个理想的模板方案。最终，我受Ziex和Templ启发，开发了zt——一个专为Zig打造的类型安全HTML模板库。它能在编译期检查所有输入类型，杜绝运行时错误；默认转义所有动态内容以防XSS；生成的代码直接写入std.Io.Writer，零分配、高性能。模板错误直接体现为Zig编译器报错，让调试变得前所未有的清晰。

articles.title: 60年谜题：橘猫为何大多为雄性
articles.summary: 如果你养过橘猫，一定知道它们性格独特。如今科学证实，它们在基因上确实与众不同。经过60年的研究，科学家终于揭开了橘色毛发的遗传秘密。研究发现，这种毛色源于猫基因组中一段非编码DNA的缺失，导致Arhgap36基因过度表达。该突变位于X染色体上，解释了为何大多数橘猫是雄性，而雌性橘猫通常呈现三花或玳瑁色。尽管橘猫常被调侃“不太聪明”，但研究证实这种基因突变对健康和智力并无负面影响。

articles.summary: 数据视频融合数据可视化与视频叙事，广泛用于新闻与商业分析。提出DataVista诊断基准，评估多模态大语言模型在动态图表数据读取、跨模态证据整合等方面的能力，揭示其在数据视频理解上的不足，为提升相关能力提供方向。

articles.title: Surfing the Activation Wave: Analyzing the Information and Geometry of LLM Hidden States for Speculative Decoding
articles.excerpt: Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers
articles.summary: 大语言模型不同层的隐藏状态编码互补信息，但现有投机解码通常用固定启发式选择少量目标层。通过分析隐藏状态的信息与几何特性，提出更优的层子集选择方法，提升投机解码的草稿接受率与推理速度。

articles.title: From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning
articles.excerpt: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. However, conventional medical benchmarks assess reasoning over preselected evidence rather than the ability to seek it across clinical records and longitudinal imaging. We propose CASE: a series of role-specific Clinical Agen
articles.summary: 传统医学基准只评估对预设证据的推理，而非跨临床记录和纵向影像主动搜集证据的能力。提出CASE系列角色特定临床智能体，通过工具调用主动收集长期医学证据，训练基础模型进行纵向医学推理，弥合“给定证据”与“主动搜集证据”之间的差距。

articles.title: MixTok: Adaptive Visual Tokenization with Global 1D Tokens and Sparse 2D Refinement
articles.excerpt: Efficient visual tokenization requires balancing representation compactness with the preservation of fine-grained image content. Conventional grid-based tokenizers allocate tokens uniformly across spatial locations despite non-uniform visual complexity, whereas compact 1D tokenizers aggregate global
articles.summary: 针对视觉tokenization中紧凑性与细粒度内容保留的平衡难题，提出MixTok自适应视觉tokenizer。结合全局1D token与稀疏2D细化，根据视觉复杂度自适应分配token，在保持压缩效率的同时提升细粒度图像内容还原能力。

articles.title: Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows
articles.excerpt: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user mes
articles.summary: 收集JetBrains IDE中真实软件工程师的4,782个智能体会话（Production Sessions），发现现有编码智能体基准与用户实际任务流不匹配。主张基准应贴合真实交互流程，基于生产会话设计评估方法，提升编码智能体评测的现实性。

articles.title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
articles.excerpt: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their s
articles.summary: 现有视觉-触觉数据集规模有限，难以支撑具身学习。构建TouchScale数据集，包含500小时人类第一视角视觉与触觉同步数据，记录接触与压力信息，为视觉-触觉学习提供大规模物理监督信号，推动具身智能体的交互理解。

articles.title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
articles.excerpt: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret o
articles.summary: 传统知识蒸馏需训练学生模型参数，导致知识绑定特定架构与检查点。提出通用文本教学（Universal Textual Teaching），将教师模型的知识以文本形式显式表达，无需训练学生参数，使学生模型可跨架构解释与复用，提升蒸馏知识的可迁移性与可解释性。

articles.title: PreSTO: Predictive Subtree Prefetching for Fast LLM Power Sampling
articles.excerpt: Power sampling improves large language model (LLM) reasoning at test time by sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution. Its sampler, PowerMH, is slow because its Metropolis--Hastings (MH) updates are sequential: each accept/reject decision sets the state from which the next
articles.summary: Power sampling通过锐化分布提升LLM推理，但其采样器PowerMH的Metropolis-Hastings更新串行导致速度慢。提出PreSTO预测性子树预取，提前并行探索多个接受/拒绝路径，减少串行等待，显著加速LLM测试时功率采样。

articles.title: When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?
articles.excerpt: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and sing
articles.summary: 生物推理模型声称通过后训练连接LLM与生物基础模型表示及文本，但基准准确率是否证明模型真的使用了这些生物输入？系统测试六个跨DNA、蛋白质和单细胞模型，揭示模型在何种条件下依赖生物输入，为生物推理模型的可信评估提供依据。

articles.title: The value of information and the emergence of communication in evolved e-puck robots
articles.excerpt: We study when communication emerges between autonomous agents and what role an innate action selection architecture plays. Two e-puck robots, reconstructed in PyBullet from their Webots model and validated against it, must find a feeding zone that can only be detected when a robot passes over it. Ea
articles.summary: 研究自主智能体之间何时涌现通信，以及先天动作选择架构的作用。在PyBullet中重建两台e-puck机器人，它们需寻找只能由机器人经过时检测到的进食区。通过进化方法分析信息价值与通信出现的条件，揭示架构对通信演化的影响。

articles.title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
articles.excerpt: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Dist
articles.summary: MoE Transformer通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但路由不完美时负载均衡可能将token发送到训练不足的专家。提出分布鲁棒MoE训练方法，优化路由与专家训练以应对分配偏差，提升稀疏专家模型的可靠性与泛化性能。

articles.title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
articles.excerpt: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, cha
articles.summary: 多头潜在注意力（MLA）以紧凑缓存实现多注意力，但KV缓存仍随上下文和批次线性增长。提出QuantMLA，针对MLA内容路径与解耦RoPE路径建立量化误差模型，采用功能对齐的双路径低比特量化，在极低比特下压缩KV缓存同时保持注意力质量。

articles.title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
articles.excerpt: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVE
articles.summary: 视频语言模型常假设更多时序观测带来更可靠推理。本文质疑该假设，提出SAVE方法：从密集视频参考中学习强化稀疏视频推理，使模型在有限时序证据下仍能可靠推理，而非仅追求高效处理更多帧。

articles.title: ThinkDrag: Semantic Drag-Based Image Editing with Visual Reasoning
articles.excerpt: Drag-based image editing provides an intuitive interface for spatially controlled image manipulation by allowing users to specify handle and target points. Existing methods have made substantial progress through optimization-based, one-step, and feed-forward formulations, but they often interpret dr
articles.summary: 拖拽式图像编辑通过用户指定手柄点和目标点实现空间控制，但现有方法常忽略拖拽的语义含义。提出ThinkDrag，结合视觉推理理解拖拽意图，在编辑过程中注入语义理解，实现更符合用户期望的拖拽式图像编辑。
